visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Letters Printed as Numbers
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The report should read i: 4, m: 1 and so on, but it prints numbers such as 105: 4 instead of letters.

solution.explanation: 'a' + i adds a char and an int, which gives an int (97 + 8 = 105). Without the (char) cast the number is printed instead of the letter. The cast turns the number back into a character.
